tasks.task: Write a build spec for one automation

items.when: When a client names a repeat task and you need the steps from intake to live in order
When you know the task and need trigger, steps, field map, dedupe key and error paths written out
Before the full spec, to lay the task out step by step and see what can break
When the tool is not chosen, to compare a Zapier or Make set-up with switching to code
When the spec is drafted, to list the odd cases to test, smallest first
When the spec covers only the happy path and must say what happens when people or data go wrong

tasks.task: Rank which repeat tasks to automate first

items.when: When the team has not listed its weekly chores yet and you need the list to score
When there is a list of repeat jobs and you must pick three to automate and what to leave
When a task is slow because work waits, to see which steps are waste before automating them
Before you automate a step, to find what it quietly does that nobody wrote down
When a task is risky, to get a verdict on automating it, a fallback and tests to pass
When the client wants to automate a bad process, to fix the handoffs first

tasks.task: Diagnose an automation that fails, runs twice or misses records

items.when: When you have run history and step settings and need the cause, the fix and a retest
When there is an error message or log from a step and you need the cause and a working fix
When an n8n workflow breaks quietly and needs clear errors, retries and alerts
When a scheduled run skips or repeats, to read the schedule and its next run times
When guesses pile up, to follow one real run step by step and measure before changing anything

tasks.task: Review a new automation before anyone relies on it

items.when: When a new automation is built and you must find double runs, missed records and silent fails
When you want a guided run to a test checklist, a written procedure and recovery steps
When several tools join up, to check each join and what wins when events pile up
When you need the test cases for odd data, such as blanks, repeats and late events
When everyone is sure it works, to turn it upside down and ask how it would fail

tasks.task: Choose the platform: Zapier, Make, n8n or code

items.when: When you know the task, apps and volume and need a tool pick with reasons
When two or three tools are close, to score them with criteria, cost and a trial plan
When the apps are common and the owner wants the simplest tool to look after
When the flow branches a lot and the owner wants to see it on a canvas
When the business needs to self-host, inspect each step or keep run costs low

tasks.task: Write a code step that cleans data inside an automation

items.when: When a Zap, scenario or workflow must split names, fix phones, sum lines or pull a number from text
When the rule is tricky, to write the rules and odd cases first and then the code
When you need realistic test rows with blanks and odd values to run the step against
When the step is written, to catch repeated logic and common slips before it goes in

tasks.task: Build a webhook intake that checks, dedupes and answers fast

items.when: When a shop, payment tool or form sends events and fake, repeat or late ones must do no harm
When the intake must be code, to get a receiver that checks signatures and handles repeats
When the endpoint exists, to get a test plan with auth, failure and odd cases
Before go-live, to review the receiver for bugs and security gaps

tasks.task: Connect a tool that has no built-in app

items.when: When a service has an API but no connector, to get code with sign-in, errors and retries
When the API says slow down, to add safe waiting, retrying and backing off
When the tool has no API at all, to try doing the task in a browser by script
When keys and logins sit in steps or sheets, to review storage and rotation

tasks.task: Write a Python script for a repeat file job

items.when: When a weekly file job takes an hour by hand and needs a script that shows changes first
When a trigger, file watcher or schedule may suit better than a script run by hand
When you must test without the real files
When the script is drafted, to review bugs, clarity and tests with a fix for each point

tasks.task: Clean and reshape a messy export

items.when: When an export has stray spaces, text numbers, mixed dates and duplicates
When the same file comes every week, to fix, re-check and save the rules for next time
When the file is big, to fix it with a few tested rules and a list of risky rows
When two exports must match, to see unmatched rows and duplicate keys explained
When the clean file is ready, to report gaps, duplicates and odd values left

tasks.task: Build an Excel or PDF report by script

items.when: When the report comes from weekly exports and must build the same way each time
When you need a script and a reusable template for a PDF, Word or Excel file
When one file is needed now, built from a spec with no script to keep
When the workbook has formulas, to list errors and broken links before it is sent

tasks.task: Fix a Python script that fails

items.when: When you have the traceback or log and need the cause and a fix
When the script is wrong or slow with no error, to find the cause step by step

tasks.task: Write a run and schedule guide for scripts

items.when: When a non-developer must run the job, to give exact steps, fixes and who to call
When the job runs on a timer, to confirm what the schedule means and its next run times
When the script needs a README and usage notes that match what the code does
When the guide is written, to mark each step working or broken on a first run

tasks.task: Design an Airtable base or a Notion workspace

items.when: When a team tracks things in scattered sheets and needs tables, fields, links and views per role
When the things tracked link in many ways, to get clean tables and links first
When the design invents new structure, to link what exists and keep formats simple
When the design is drafted, to have a fresh reviewer read it as the team that must use it

tasks.task: Plan a move off spreadsheets into one base

items.when: Before the move, to fix the target tables and fields the old sheets must map to
When each old column needs a target field, a rule and a decision to review
When you need the move in steps with field maps, checks and a way back
When the old sheets must be cleaned before import
After a trial import, to check blanks, duplicates, broken links and stale rows

tasks.task: Review a messy base or workspace

items.when: When a base has duplicate tables, free-text fields and views nobody opens
When the workspace holds how-to pages, to find missing owners, stale pages and gaps
When the records are in doubt, to report gaps, duplicates and odd values

tasks.task: Switch an automation on and tell the team

items.when: When the automation is built and tested and someone with access will switch it on
When you need the checks, the way back and how to know it worked on the day
Before the switch, to list launch checks, open blockers and a decision record
When the team must be told what they do differently and from when

tasks.task: Run the monthly automation health check

items.when: Monthly, and straight after any failure alert that repeats
When the check finds a flow that fails, runs twice or burns through its plan
When plans and add-ons have grown, to find duplicate tools and what to cut

tasks.task: Plan failure alerts that reach a real person

items.when: When each error path needs an owner, a message and what to do with the stuck record
When the flow is in n8n and needs retries and alerts added
When a custom endpoint or script must be watched, with alert rules that avoid alert fatigue
When the person alerted needs steps to follow under pressure
When alerts exist but nobody acts, to check priorities, warnings and human mistakes

tasks.task: Design and build an n8n workflow

items.when: When you know the task and need the workflow laid out on a proven pattern
When you want one run to a workflow with visible failures and reusable parts
When a workflow has grown long and should be split into parts with clear inputs
Before it goes live, to list the cases to run through the workflow

tasks.task: Add an AI step or agent to an automation

items.when: When an n8n agent needs its tools, memory and review steps set up
When the AI step must always return the same fields so later steps do not break
When the step reads scans or invoices, to pull facts and check them against the page
When the AI can act, to set which actions need a person and when to escalate
Before relying on it, to build a test set, scoring rules and a release decision

tasks.task: Spec a Power Automate flow or a Power Apps screen

items.when: When a Microsoft 365 process needs its people, tools and data flow mapped first
When IT needs the flow's trigger, steps, approvals and error handling in a spec to support

tasks.task: Write the run book and hand over ownership

items.when: When a new owner takes over, to get a procedure, an exception guide and practice tasks
When one task needs exact steps, fixes if it fails and how to roll back
When the flow is critical and needs steps anyone can follow when it breaks
When run books exist, to find missing owners and stale pages

tasks.task: Check an automation's data, access and privacy risks

items.when: When the flow moves personal data, to list privacy risks and whether an assessment is needed
When shared logins and keys run the flows, to review storage and rotation
When the flow sends messages or decides about people, to set where a person must approve
When the process is sensitive, to get the risks, a safe design and tests before go-live

always.when: Before you call any automation tested or live, to get a one-page sign-off with proof
Before a spec is handed over, to catch field and step names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When the job needs a hosted endpoint or service, not a step inside a no-code tool
When the fix belongs in Excel or Google Sheets formulas, not in an automation
When the team needs app screens and forms on top of the base
When accounts, licences, permissions or Microsoft 365 admin settings must change
When the automation routes leads or changes CRM stages and scoring
When the AI step needs evaluation, retrieval or a model choice beyond one prompt

gaps: No library item covers Airtable: formulas, linked records, interfaces, automations and record limits; only the kit skill does
No library item designs a Notion workspace: databases, relations, templates and permissions
No library item specs a Power Automate flow, writes Power Fx formulas or specs a Power Apps screen on SharePoint or Dataverse
No library item is specific to Zapier or Make builds: paths, filters, routers, and task or operation budgets
No library item estimates hours saved, run cost and payback for an automation
No library item writes or tests a text pattern to pull order numbers, dates or phones out of free text
No library item covers Google Apps Script or automations inside Google Sheets
No library item reads a run history export to find the failing step and the records it missed
No library item writes a brief a freelancer or tool builder can quote and build from
No library item writes a one-page team guide for a new base or workspace
No library item covers the US, UK and EU rules for automated messages and automated decisions about people
